description_en: Deletes a layout in a virtual studio
description_zh: 删除虚拟演播厅的布局设置
name: DeleteStudioLayout

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the production studio.

If you created the production studio by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html operation, use the CasterId value returned in the response.

If you created the production studio in the ApsaraVideo Live console, choose ApsaraVideo Live console > Production Studio > Cloud Production Studio to view the ID.

The name of the production studio in the list is its ID
parameters.help_zh:
导播台ID。

如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过直播控制台 > 导播台 > 云导播台页面查看。

直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID
parameters.name: caster_id

parameters.help_en: The layout ID. If you added the layout to the production studio by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848062.html operation, use the LayoutId value returned in the response
parameters.help_zh: 布局ID。如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848062.html添加虚拟演播厅的布局设置，请查看AddStudioLayout接口调用返回的参数LayoutId值
parameters.name: layout_id
